The '''Bodrin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bodrin]].<ref name="PotG3" />
